item.title: Receptor & Reason 2026-09-29 — what the stand-in actually preserves: Dementia Language Models fine-tuned on one picture-description corpus encode cognitive impairment well enough that a classifier trained only on their synthetic Iowa Gambling Task play identifies human MCI at ROC-AUC 0.722 against 0.657 for a classifier trained on the humans themselves, while causal patching shows nothing is broken (same dominant layers, r ≥ 0.998) and Healthy-to-Dementia weight interpolation drops predicted MMSE 1.47-1.85 points per unit; PASCode scores 1.5 million phenotype-associated cells across 6.3 million nuclei from ~1,500 PsychAD brains and finds depression within Alzheimer's is astrocyte- and oligodendrocyte-led with interleukin-18 up and no Alzheimer's modules in the same cells; kynurenic acid's polygenic score beats measured serum kynurenic acid as a lithium-response predictor in 457 bipolar patients and is the only Mayo Biobank finding to survive correction; 7-tesla MRS finds NO regional glutamate difference in 47 antipsychotic-free first-episode psychosis patients (all p > 0.2) but inter-regional correlations in 6 of 10 region pairs that controls do not show; tirzepatide blocks nicotine place preference, reinstatement, locomotor sensitisation and accumbal dopamine in male mice; itraconazole plus lacosamide rescues CGG-repeat neurotoxicity in a FXTAS fly model at a fourfold lower itraconazole dose; cryo-EM at 2.99 and 2.81 angstroms shows C101248 and the Phase-II-bound CVN293 occupy the same THIK1 vestibule and remodel the same Y273 gate, yet C-terminal deletion cuts CVN293's maximal inhibition 84.8% to 71.2% while enhancing C101248's; state-specific FEP over 78 ligand-channel pairs and four superfamilies separates agonists from antagonists at gaps under 1 kcal/mol because systematic errors correlate ~0.94 between states, predicts 5-HT-3A maximum response to 6% RMSE, and works on a GluA2 template with no pore domain at all; T-REX beats a non-agentic tree search 2.43-fold on structurally distinct in silico binder hits with zero wet-lab validation; MechBench separates phenomenal-law recovery (35.00%) from mechanism recovery (13.75%) and finds mechanism fails in 64.29% of cases where the law is right, with Monod-Wyman-Changeux allostery among the 16 task families; AutoBCI's discovered EEG architecture beats the best of ten baselines by 0.29 percentage points while its performance forecaster cuts prediction error 38.1%; and a 77-language ambient-scribe audit finds 3.4% serious errors in note generation alone but 24% end-to-end at the hardest complexity tier, with 87% of serious note errors ASR-derived and amplification outrunning correction threefold
item.description: Twelve items, and a thread: what does a computational stand-in actually preserve? The lead is Dementia Language Models, which asks a harder question than the speech-based detection literature has asked — not whether a model can imitate impaired speech, but whether it has learned a transferable representation of cognitive impairment. Two results say it has: the frozen models' internal representations improve MCI classification in an unseen cohort where both conventional baselines sit at chance, and a classifier trained purely on the models' synthetic Iowa Gambling Task behaviour identifies human MCI about as well as one trained on the human data. The mechanistic reading is the careful part — nothing in the network is damaged, and impairment turns out to be a direction in weight space rather than a deterioration, which is what gives you a dial. Then the PsychAD consortium's PASCode, whose real contribution is decoupling cell-type prioritisation from cell abundance, and whose most useful slice is depression inside Alzheimer's: subtract the Alzheimer's signal and what remains is astrocyte- and oligodendrocyte-led, matches the MDD literature including its sex-specific pattern, carries interleukin-18, and contains depression gene modules but not Alzheimer's ones. Two Translational Psychiatry results worth knowing for opposite reasons: a polygenic score for kynurenic acid outpredicting the metabolite it predicts for lithium response, which is what you expect when a single serum draw is a noisy read on lifetime exposure; and a clean 7-tesla null on regional glutamate in medication-naive first-episode psychosis, with the signal relocated into inter-regional covariance. Straight pharmacology follows: tirzepatide against nicotine, where the interesting part is reinstatement and sensitisation rather than acute reward, and a dual incretin agonist is the one class that could address post-cessation weight gain at the same time; and an itraconazole-plus-lacosamide combination for FXTAS that targets an RNA structure rather than a protein, with a fourfold dose reduction, two already-approved drugs and an unusually short translational path from flies. The structural-pharmacology centrepiece is a THIK1 pair that shows how little chemical similarity guarantees: same scaffold, same vestibular site, same inner-gate remodelling, near-identical potency — and the C-terminal gate stabilises the inhibited state for the clinical candidate while opposing it for the tool compound. If you are optimising residence time here, the selectivity filter is not the lever. That sets up the week's best conceptual computational result: predicting efficacy rather than affinity by taking the difference of binding free energies to active and inactive conformations. It resolves sub-kilocalorie gaps because systematic FEP errors cancel between near-identical states, it goes quantitative on 5-HT-3A maximum response, and its widest claim is that local pocket conformation encodes efficacy even when the global channel state is ambiguous — demonstrated on a GluA2 template missing its pore entirely. Two agentic items: T-REX, where the design insight is that cheap language-model reasoning over campaign summaries can steer expensive folding compute, and every hit is still in silico; and MechBench, which draws the Kepler-versus-Newton line that autonomous-discovery benchmarks have blurred, and finds agents recover the observable law far more often than the mechanism generating it — with Monod-Wyman-Changeux allostery and Goldman channel flux literally among the tasks, which is the same two-state distinction the FEP paper is built on. Closing lighter: an agentic EEG architecture search whose architecture gain is a wash and whose performance forecaster is the actual product, and an ambient-scribe audit showing that two individually safe layers compose into an unsafe system, with the generation layer amplifying upstream transcription errors three times as often as it corrects them. Note: bioRxiv's metadata API was fully healthy (1,975 records swept day by day) but its Cloudflare layer throttled full-text fetches, deferring three otherwise-eligible preprints.
item.itunes:summary: Twelve items on what a computational stand-in preserves. Dementia Language Models learn cognitive impairment as a controllable direction in weight space, not as damage — and their synthetic Iowa Gambling Task behaviour identifies human MCI about as well as human training data does. PASCode dissects depression inside Alzheimer's across 6.3 million nuclei and lands on astrocytes, oligodendrocytes and interleukin-18. A kynurenic acid polygenic score outpredicts measured kynurenic acid for lithium response; a 7-tesla study finds no regional glutamate difference in first-episode psychosis but abnormal inter-regional covariance. Tirzepatide blocks nicotine reinstatement and sensitisation; itraconazole plus lacosamide rescues a FXTAS fly model at a fourfold lower dose. Two THIK1 structures show the same site and scaffold behaving differently at the C-terminal gate. State-specific free energy perturbation predicts efficacy rather than affinity across four ion-channel superfamilies, resolving sub-kilocalorie gaps because systematic errors cancel between states. T-REX orchestrates binder-design compute 2.4-fold better than tree search, all in silico. MechBench separates recovering a law from recovering a mechanism and finds agents fail the second even when they pass the first. And an ambient-scribe audit shows two safe layers composing into an unsafe system.
